description: Begin linking the agent's owning wallet to Telegram. Two-step, proving owner-wallet control (the link is minted FOR that wallet). Step 1 — omit agent_sig: returns an EIP-712 commitment, nonce, and expiry to sign with the owner wallet. Step 2 — include nonce, expiry, and agent_sig over that commitment: verifies the signature recovers the agent's on-chain owner, then returns a t.me deep link (deep_link + expires_at) the human taps to finish linking in Telegram.

agent_id.description: The agent whose owner wallet to link to Telegram

agent_sig.description: EIP-712 signature over the step-1 commitment proving owner-wallet control; omit for step 1

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

name: link_telegram
